references.text: The sacrifice must be a male without defect from the cattle, to be accepted with favor by the Lord.
The burnt offering may also come from the flock, from sheep or goats, and must be a male without defect.
A peace offering from the cattle must be without defect to be accepted by the Lord.
A peace offering from the flock must also be without defect, whether male or female.
The sin offering must be a bull without defect.
Same context: The sacrifice must be without defect to be accepted.
The Passover lamb was to be a male without defect, either from the sheep or the goats.
Animals with defects must not be offered to the Lord.
Animals with defects or flaws are an abomination to the Lord and must not be offered.
The prophet Malachi rebukes the people for offering animals with defects instead of those without blemish.
Christ is compared to a spotless lamb, as the fulfillment of the requirement for a perfect sacrifice.
Christ offered himself without defect to God, as the perfect sacrifice.
